channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 23 Aug: Harare mainly clear · high 27° / low 14°
item.description: Harare: high 27°, low 14° (mainly clear) · Bulawayo: high 28°, low 15° (partly cloudy) · Mutare: high 26°, low 12° (clear sky) · Gweru: high 28°, low 14° (overcast) · Masvingo: high 29°, low 12° (overcast) · Victoria Falls: high 31°, low 15° (clear sky) Tsumo yezuva: Mwana asingachemi anofira mumbereko. (A child who does not cry dies on its mother’s back.) #Zimbabwe #Weather #ZimbabweWeather #ZimbabweNews
